2608.04586.title: Breaking the Curse ofMultilinguality inMany-to-Many Speech-to-Text Translation via a Resource-AwareMixture of Speech Encoders
2608.04586.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant success in speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, when processing multilingual speech inputs, a single speech encoder shared across all languages suffers from the curse of multilinguality: languages at different resource levels compete for limited representation capacity, leading to strong high-resource performance but substantial degradation on low-resource speech. To address this problem and improve multilingual consistency, we propose MSRT, a novel framework built around a resource-aware Mixture of Speech Encoders (MoSE). MoSE uses an explicit language router to assign each utterance to an appropriate expert encoder. A frozen expert preserves high-resource language capabilities, while a trainable expert adapts to and specializes in medium- and low-resource languages. We further introduce a five-stage curriculum learning strategy that substantially reduces data dependence, requiring only 10 hours of paired S2TT data per language for effective alignment. We conduct extensive experiments on 45 languages, systematically evaluating all $45 \times 44$ translation directions. Our 4B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming substantially larger baselines. Empirical analyses show that MoSE improves high-, medium-, and low-resource languages simultaneously, with the largest gains on low-resource speech, thereby breaking the curse of multilinguality without compromising high-resource performance. To support future multilingual S2TT research, we release our code and models.
2608.04586.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在語音轉文字翻譯（S2TT）方面取得了顯著成功。<lb/>然而，在處理多語言語音輸入時，跨所有語言共享的單一語音編碼器受到多語言性的詛咒：不同資源水平的語言競爭有限的表示能力，導致高資源語言表現強勁，但低資源語音的性能顯著下降。<lb/>為了解決這個問題並改善多語言的一致性，我們提出了MSRT，一個圍繞資源感知的語音編碼器混合體（MoSE）構建的新框架。<lb/>MoSE使用明確的語言路由器將每個發話分配給合適的專家編碼器。<lb/>一個凍結的專家保留了高資源語言的能力，而一個可訓練的專家則適應並專精於中低資源語言。<lb/>我們進一步引入了一個五階段的課程學習策略，顯著減少數據依賴，對於有效的對齊，每種語言只需10小時的配對S2TT數據。<lb/>我們在45種語言上進行了廣泛的實驗，系統地評估了所有$45 \times 44$的翻譯方向。<lb/>我們的4B參數模型達到了最先進的性能，顯著超越了更大基準模型。<lb/>實證分析顯示，MoSE同時改善了高、中、低資源語言的性能，並在低資源語音上獲得了最大的增益，從而打破了多語言性的詛咒，而不妥協高資源的性能。<lb/>為了支持未來的多語言S2TT研究，我們發布了我們的代碼和模型。
